core_loop: Aim / throw / perform a short skill action
Reach a new zone or attract a rarer creature
Earn passive rewards and upgrade range / power
game_design.target_audience: Broad casual Roblox audience; collection, discovery and satisfying progression; mobile-first.
game_design.map_design_requirements: Readable hub with a clear throwing lane, visible distant targets, distinct habitat islands, safe return path and one obvious next unlock.
game_design.session_design: A 2–5 minute first success, then repeatable 7–12 minute upgrade and collection sessions.

art_direction.label: Classic Roblox Stud
art_direction.geometry: chunky modular forms, visible stud language, simple readable silhouettes
art_direction.materials: matte plastic, restrained metal, clean color blocks
art_direction.lighting: bright readable daylight, soft ambient shadows
art_direction.ui: bold playful panels, thick outlines, large icons

design_principles: Get to the first satisfying action quickly
Make the next goal visible in-world and in UI
Use a small number of distinct visual signals for rarity and importance
Design mobile-first touch targets and keep the central play area unobstructed
Keep visual effects subordinate to gameplay readability
Create short-, medium- and long-term goals without forcing purchases

title: Verdant Frontier
overview: Verdant Frontier: Throw food as far as possible to attract and collect animals from different habitats. Train throw power, buy better food, reach new areas, collect rare creatures and earn cash from them.. Authored with a focal landmark, readable districts, natural terrain silhouettes, exploration loops and sightline hierarchy.
